meta.name: Sketchy AF: Monty Python's Flying Circus
meta.description:
And now for something completely different: it’s a channel that’s home to the funniest comedians and sketchiest characters that ever aired on television. For sheer laughs-per-minute, you can’t top Pluto TV’s Sketchy AF.

Shows: Monty Python's Flying Circus, Crank Yankers, Beavis and Butt-Head, The Whitest Kids U' Know, Key & Peele
Available on: Pluto TV
